title: Hex.pm registry unauthenticated RCE (CVE-2026-129514, CVSS 10.0) exploited against six hex.pm servers on Nov 23
why: Hex.pm's own incident post (Nov 24) confirms an attacker ran commands on six web servers on Nov 23 via CVE-2026-129514 (GHSA-9pmm-hf4r-27pg); covered by THN and SOCRadar. Not in CISA KEV (catalog 2026.11.25) and no Microsoft advisory or Defender coverage seen. Nov 27 09Z recheck: not in CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.25 (no KEV adds since Nov 25) and no new MSRC entry for it this run.
action: Have Elixir/Erlang developers change hex.pm passwords and reset 2FA, rotate Hex API keys used in CI, fetch only from repo.hex.pm (no mirrors) until the new signed Hex client ships, and review recent releases/ownership changes on your packages.
product: hex.pm package registry service (hexpm Erlang-term request-body parser, pre-fix)

title: Drupal core installer access bypass (SA-CORE-2026-019, CVE-2026-136716) exploited for site takeover
why: Drupal's emergency advisory SA-CORE-2026-019 (Nov 25) says attackers are already using CVE-2026-136716 against live Drupal 10 and 11 sites; The Hacker News, HeroDevs and CUHK ITSC report it. It covers install states that the Nov 18 fix for CVE-2026-132165 (in KEV since Nov 24) left open. CVE-2026-136716 itself is not in CISA KEV (catalog 2026.11.25), and there is no Microsoft signal. Nov 27 09Z recheck: not in CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.25 (no KEV adds since Nov 25) and no new MSRC entry for it this run.
action: Upgrade Drupal core to 10.6.23, 11.3.23 or 11.4.14, run the database update hooks, block remote access to install.php, and check user 1 and other admin accounts for takeover.
product: Drupal core before 10.6.23 / 11.3.23 / 11.4.14 (sites in an unusual or incomplete install state)

title: GeoServer: attackers probing CVE-2026-129243 OWS auth bypass and CVE-2026-120705 file read, part of a public 5-bug unauthenticated RCE chain
why: watchTowr reported error-based exploit probes (creating/invoking stored queries) against both CVEs after GeoServer's Nov 23 advisories; a Rapid7 researcher published PoC for the 5-bug unauth RCE chain (THN, SecurityWeek). Neither CVE is in CISA KEV (2026.11.25); no Microsoft signal. Nov 27 09Z recheck: not in CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.25 (no KEV adds since Nov 25) and no new MSRC entry for it this run.
action: Upgrade internet-facing GeoServer to 2.27.7 / 2.28.6 / 3.0.2 now, and review logs for anonymous CreateStoredQuery / stored-query WFS requests since Nov 23.

title: GL.iNet GoodCloud cloud-management flaw exploited to plant malware on GL.iNet routers and KVM devices
why: GL.iNet's security notice (issued Nov 20, updated Nov 23) confirms an unauthorized party exploited a vulnerability in its GoodCloud remote-management service to install malware on some routers and KVM devices. BleepingComputer, The Hacker News, SecurityWeek and Cybernews covered it Nov 22-23; Cybernews cites researchers who found malware or older backdoors on 166 of 199 routers they analyzed. There is no CVE, it is not in CISA KEV, and there is no Microsoft signal. KVMs give the attacker a path to the connected computers. Nov 27 09Z recheck: not in CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.25 (no KEV adds since Nov 25) and no new MSRC entry for it this run.
action: Install the GL.iNet security firmware for each router or KVM model, check devices for the infection indicator in GL.iNet's notice, and, if a KVM was infected, check the computers connected to it.
product: GL.iNet routers and remote KVMs managed through GoodCloud (security firmware per model, e.g. GL-MT3000/MT6000 4.11.1, KVM RM1 1.10.3)

affected.product: GL.iNet GL-AX1800 / AXT1800 / SFT1200 / X3000 / XE3000 firmware
GL.iNet KVM RM1 / RM1V2 / RM10 / RM10RC / RM1PE / RM4PE firmware

title: VMware vCenter vmdir unauthenticated authentication bypass (CVE-2026-123903, 9.8): unverified public PoC claimed
why: Broadcom VMSA-2026-0011 (Nov 24) fixes a 9.8 network authentication bypass in vCenter's directory service. On Nov 24 a GitHub repository claiming a working PoC appeared (reported by The Layman Security, Rescana and Mallory; none verified it). No exploitation reported yet, not in CISA KEV (catalog 2026.11.24). Update: Rapid7 ETR (Nov 25) validated that the public PoC achieves the authentication bypass; Rapid7 still reports no known exploitation in the wild. Nov 27 09Z recheck: not in CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.25 (no KEV adds since Nov 25) and no new MSRC entry for it this run. Rapid7 ETR (Nov 25) still reports no in-the-wild exploitation; public PoC validated.
action: Patch vCenter to 9.1.2, 9.0.2.0300 or 8.0 U3m (VCF 5.2.5) now, and keep vCenter management interfaces off untrusted networks.
product: VMware vCenter Server 9.1.x, 9.0.x, 8.0, 7.0 (and VCF/vSphere Foundation/Telco Cloud vCenter)

title: 1Password breach: hijacked employee GitHub account used to push malicious backend code and steal customer account data and source code
why: 1Password disclosed on Nov 25 that an attacker took over an employee's corporate GitHub account, pushed malicious code to backend services and downloaded customer administrative data (names, emails, account identifiers) plus source code; BleepingComputer, The Hacker News and Cybernews report it. Vault contents and keys were not accessed, per 1Password. No CVE, not in CISA KEV, and no Microsoft advisory or Defender coverage seen. Nov 27 09Z recheck: not in CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.25 (no KEV adds since Nov 25) and no new MSRC entry for it this run.
action: Warn staff who use 1Password about phishing that mentions 1Password (fake invitations or account-recovery requests) and review 1Password business admin and activity logs for unexpected recovery or invite events.

title: Cacti 1.2.31 zero-day '4HTTP2SHELL/4HTTP2ROOT': unauthenticated RCE via guest access in four HTTP requests, public PoC, no CVE or patch
why: Seen Nov 27 in The Hacker News, Mallory and Threadlinqs: researcher 'ek0ms savi0r' published a working PoC (Previdian verified it in a lab) for unauthenticated command execution in Cacti 1.2.31. No CVE, no vendor fix, no in-the-wild exploitation reported yet; not in CISA KEV and no Microsoft advisory or Defender coverage seen.
action: Disable Cacti guest access now, restrict the Cacti web UI to admin networks, and review poller command settings for unexpected entries.
product: Cacti 1.2.31 (latest release) and likely earlier, when anonymous guest access is enabled

title: FortiOS LDAP auth-bypass (CVE-2026-22153) probe script found in an active intrusion crew's toolkit alongside Exchange, Citrix and PHP2Shell exploits
why: Hunt.io (Nov 26) recovered three open directories of an active crew that stole US hospital credentials and accessed a manufacturer's Azure storage; its kit includes fg_ldapbypass.sh, a probe for the CVE-2026-22153 FortiOS LDAP empty-password bypass, used against FortiGate SSL VPNs. CVE-2026-22153 is not in CISA KEV (catalog 2026.11.25); no Microsoft advisory or Defender coverage seen. Hunt.io describes this as kit capability; no confirmed victim compromised via this CVE. Nov 27 09Z recheck: not in CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.25 (no KEV adds since Nov 25) and no new MSRC entry for it this run.
action: Upgrade FortiGates on 7.6.0-7.6.4 to a fixed 7.6 release per Fortinet's advisory, and review SSL VPN / FSSO logins that authenticated via LDAP with empty passwords.
product: FortiOS 7.6.0 through 7.6.4 (Agentless VPN / FSSO policies with LDAP server configured in a specific way)

title: SAP confirms security incident: stolen employee GitHub tokens reportedly used to copy and alter source code ('Project Granite')
why: SAP confirmed suspicious activity on its GitHub platform (dpa/FAZ, Nov 26); DER SPIEGEL and Handelsblatt report stolen employee tokens, copied and altered source code, rotated signing keys and paused automation. No CVE, not in CISA KEV, no Microsoft advisory; whether customer software was affected is unconfirmed.
action: Watch SAP's official statements and SAP Notes for affected components or signing-key changes, verify signatures on recently downloaded SAP software and transports, and rotate any credentials or tokens shared with SAP development integrations.

title: Rejetto HFS 3.x session forgery to unauthenticated RCE (CVE-2026-61500): exploited since Oct 1, used by GT13 as a relay, still not in CISA KEV
why: VulnCheck has seen exploitation since Oct 1, and GreyNoise's GT13 report (Nov 23) shows the actor took over an HFS server with CVE-2026-61500 on Oct 2 to use as its relay box. The CISA KEV catalog (version 2026.11.23, checked this run) still does not list it. Nov 27 09Z recheck: not in CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.25 (no KEV adds since Nov 25) and no new MSRC entry for it this run.
action: Upgrade HFS to 3.2.1 or later (or take it offline), then rotate admin credentials and check server_code settings and admin-panel logs for logins you did not make.

title: Radware Cloud WAF: exposed unauthenticated management API leaked customer log-export cloud keys (AWS S3, Azure Blob, SFTP)
why: Radware's root-cause report (via BleepingComputer, Nov 24) says an internal Cloud WAF management API was reachable from the internet without authentication and was accessed on Nov 19, exposing customer contacts and, for some customers, log-export credentials. Some customers saw AWS alerts of an unfamiliar IP probing log buckets. Hosted-service incident: no CVE, no KEV entry, nothing from Microsoft. Nov 27 09Z recheck: not in CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.25 (no KEV adds since Nov 25) and no new MSRC entry for it this run.
action: If you export Radware Cloud WAF logs, rotate the S3 keys, Azure Blob keys/SAS tokens and SFTP credentials now and review storage access logs from Nov 19 on.
product: Radware Cloud WAF / AppSec (WAF, Bot) hosted service

title: Rackspace Spot breach: leaked credentials let attackers deploy pods and read customer Kubernetes Secrets; service shutting down Dec 8
why: Rackspace confirmed (BleepingComputer, SC Media) that on Nov 17 attackers used compromised credentials to deploy unauthorized pods and may have read cluster Secrets and storage files; on Nov 24 it announced Spot will be shut down Dec 8. No CVE, not in KEV, no Microsoft coverage. Nov 27 09Z recheck: not in CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.25 (no KEV adds since Nov 25) and no new MSRC entry for it this run.
action: Rotate every secret that was stored in Rackspace Spot clusters and look for use of those credentials since Nov 17; plan migration before Dec 8.

title: Exchange MRSProxy pre-auth RCE (CVE-2026-62911) exploit in active intrusion crew's kit; public PoC; Exchange 2016 fix only via ESU
why: Not ahead: MSRC published CVE-2026-62911 on Aug 11, 2026. Hunt.io (Nov 26) found cve62911_poc.py in an active crew's toolkit; a public PoC is on GitHub. Not in CISA KEV.
action: Confirm every Exchange server has the August 2026 security update (Exchange 2016 needs ESU) and enable Extended Protection; hunt for ASPX webshells.
product: Microsoft Exchange Server (MRSProxy; pre-August 2026 security update)

title: NETGEAR DGN1000 setup.cgi unauthenticated root RCE (CVE-2024-12847) still mass-exploited by Mirai/Mozi; not in CISA KEV
why: URLhaus tagged a new live malware-distribution IOC with CVE-2024-12847 this run (mirai, Mozi, php-rce); CrowdSec reports over 50,000 attacking IPs exploiting it. Still not in CISA KEV (catalog 2026.11.25); no Microsoft advisory.
action: Find and replace or isolate any DGN1000 routers (end-of-life hardware); block their management interface from the internet and alert on setup.cgi requests at the edge.

title: Vacron NVR board.cgi unauthenticated command injection (CVE-2025-34043) tagged on new Mozi malware infrastructure; not in CISA KEV
why: URLhaus tagged a new live malware IOC with CVE-2025-34043 this run (Mozi, php-rce, vacron); CISA's SSVC marks exploitation as PoC and automatable. Not in CISA KEV (catalog 2026.11.25); no Microsoft advisory.
action: Remove Vacron NVRs from internet exposure (no vendor fix is listed) and block requests to /board.cgi at the perimeter.

title: Upload2Shell: Ghostscript Type 1 font-loader use-after-free escapes -dSAFER for command execution via uploads, mail and print pipelines
why: -free in Ghostscript's Type 1 font loader that crosses the -dSAFER sandbox and runs attacker-chosen commands as the rendering process. pwn.ai lists confirmed command execution in production or lab paths, including Google's document renderer (since fixed), WordPress Core uploads (separate CVE-2026-65640, fixed Aug 12) and unauthenticated IPP print jobs to Debian 13 CUPS. Artifex fixed it in Ghostscript 10.08.0 (Sep 8). oss-security, The Hacker News and CyberSecurityNews cover it. pwn.ai says per-product PoCs are not yet published, and no exploitation in the wild has been reported. It is not in CISA KEV, and there is no Microsoft advisory or Defender guidance. Nov 27 09Z recheck: not in CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.25 (no KEV adds since Nov 25) and no new MSRC entry for it this run.
action: Update Ghostscript to 10.08.0 or your distro's package that fixes CVE-2026-125396, and check that upload, preview and print services do not pass untrusted files to Ghostscript (for example, disable PS/PDF/EPS coders in ImageMagick policy.xml).
product: Ghostscript before 10.08.0 (distro backports vary, e.g. Debian 13 fixed in 10.05.1~dfsg-1+deb13u2); reached through ImageMagick, WordPress Core uploads, CUPS and other renderers

title: VMware ESX I/O filter service unauthenticated network RCE (CVE-2026-123910 / CVE-2026-123911, CVSS 9.8, VMSA-2026-0011)
why: Broadcom VMSA-2026-0011 (Nov 24) fixes two 9.8 flaws (a heap out-of-bounds write and a use-after-free) in the ESX I/O filter service that an attacker with network access to the host can use to run code, with no guest VM access needed. No exploitation has been reported; not in CISA KEV. Nov 27 09Z recheck: not in CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.25 (no KEV adds since Nov 25) and no new MSRC entry for it this run.
action: Apply ESXi80U3m-25926933 / ESXi-9.1.2.0 / ESXi-9.0.2.0200, or the KB463535 workaround on 8.0, and limit network access to ESX management interfaces.

title: NFS2ROOT (CVE-2026-99362): pre-auth remote root in Linux kernel NFS server (nfsd, NFSv4.1 sessions), present since 3.16
why: OpenSec demonstrated a full remote-root exploit (kept private); covered by BleepingComputer (Nov 27), watchTowr FAQ and CUHK. No exploitation reported; not in CISA KEV and no Microsoft advisory seen.
action: Update NFS server kernels to the fixed stable release for your branch and reboot; until then firewall port 2049 to trusted clients or disable NFSv4.1/4.2.

title: @fastify/express and @fastify/middie path-scoped middleware bypass: unauthenticated requests skip auth/rate-limit middleware (five CVEs, CVSS 9.1)
why: Fastify published GHSA-w877-hjcp-88rc and NVD added five CVSS 9.1 CVEs on Nov 21. URL decoding and normalisation mismatches between Fastify's router and the Express or middie middleware layer let an unauthenticated request reach a route handler while skipping the path-scoped authentication, authorization or rate-limit middleware meant to protect it. @fastify/express 4.0.10 fixes it. No public PoC or exploitation has been reported. It is not in CISA KEV, and there is no Microsoft guidance. Nov 27 09Z recheck: not in CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.25 (no KEV adds since Nov 25) and no new MSRC entry for it this run.
action: Upgrade @fastify/express to 4.0.10 and @fastify/middie past 9.3.7, and move auth checks into Fastify hooks (onRequest/preHandler) instead of path-scoped middleware.

title: better-auth phone-number plugin lets attackers claim unverified numbers and take over accounts via phone OTP sign-in
why: VulnCheck assigned CVE-2026-134322 on Nov 21 for a better-auth advisory (GHSA-q747-mqgr-4gh7) fixed in the Nov 3 security release. Sign-up and other flows save phone numbers before they are verified, and phone-OTP sign-in then uses that number to pick the account, so an attacker can attach a victim's number and take over the account (CVSS 4.0 8.6, needs some user interaction). No PoC or exploitation has been reported. It is not in CISA KEV, and there is no Microsoft guidance. Nov 27 09Z recheck: not in CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.25 (no KEV adds since Nov 25) and no new MSRC entry for it this run.
action: If you use better-auth with the phone number plugin, upgrade to 1.7.16 (or 1.8.0-beta.5) and review accounts whose phone numbers were never verified.
product: better-auth 0.4.12-beta.7 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 (phone number plugin)

title: Rclone serve sftp --auth-proxy authentication bypass via cache key that omits credentials
why: NVD published CVE-2026-134352 (CVSS 9.2) on Nov 21. In rclone serve sftp with --auth-proxy, the cache key does not include the authentication material, so a later login can reuse an earlier authenticated session. It only affects that configuration. Fixed in 1.76.0. The only source is the NVD record, with no PoC or exploitation reported. It is not in CISA KEV, and there is no Microsoft guidance. Nov 27 09Z recheck: not in CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.25 (no KEV adds since Nov 25) and no new MSRC entry for it this run.
action: Upgrade rclone to 1.76.0 wherever 'rclone serve sftp --auth-proxy' runs, or stop that service until you can.

title: Synology DSM / BeeStation OS OAuth API argument injection: unauthenticated arbitrary file read/write (CVSS 9.8, Synology-SA-26:21)
why: Synology published Synology-SA-26:21 around Nov 19 for CVE-2026-120382 (CVSS 9.8, no authentication or user interaction needed). NVD published it Nov 22, and SOC Prime and DEV Community covered it Nov 21; as of Nov 20 some branches were still marked 'Ongoing' in the advisory. No exploitation or public PoC reported (OffSeq: not known to be exploited, Nov 23). Not in CISA KEV; Microsoft has no signal on it. Nov 27 09Z recheck: not in CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.25 (no KEV adds since Nov 25) and no new MSRC entry for it this run.
action: Update DSM to the fixed build for your branch; where no build is out yet, deactivate the OAuth Service package and keep DSM off the internet.
product: DiskStation Manager (DSM) 6.2-7.4 before the fixed builds; BeeStation OS 1.5

title: Spring Data Elasticsearch SpEL injection through @Query method arguments (RCE when untrusted input reaches a repository query)
why: Spring published CVE-2026-123886 (High, CVSS 8.8) on Nov 19, and NVD on Nov 23. Untrusted method arguments are evaluated as SpEL inside string-based @Query methods, which can lead to code execution. Fixed in 6.0.9 and 6.1.3. There is no public PoC or exploitation, it is not in CISA KEV, and there is no Microsoft signal. Nov 27 09Z recheck: not in CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.25 (no KEV adds since Nov 25) and no new MSRC entry for it this run.
action: Upgrade Spring Data Elasticsearch to 6.1.3 or 6.0.9 (the 5.x line is listed as affected through 5.5.13 with no open-source fix named) and find string-based @Query methods that take user input.

title: AutoGPT Platform ships a public default JWT secret: forge admin tokens (CVE-2026-130169, CVSS 10)
why: Disclosed Nov 23 (NVD/CVE, CVSS 10): AutoGPT Platform deployments that keep the hardcoded HS256 key from .env.default accept forged JWTs for any user or admin. VulDB lists AutoGPT 0.8.0 as the upgrade. No exploitation report found; OffSeq lists honeypot/exposure data without detail. Not in CISA KEV, no Microsoft signal. Nov 27 09Z recheck: not in CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.25 (no KEV adds since Nov 25) and no new MSRC entry for it this run.
action: Rotate the JWT secret in every self-hosted AutoGPT deployment (never use the .env.default value), upgrade past 0.7.4, and invalidate existing sessions.

title: Chrome critical sandbox escape in Variations (CVE-2026-134401) fixed in 158.0.8127.88; Edge fix not yet seen
why: Google shipped Chrome 158.0.8127.88/.89 on Nov 23 for a Critical-rated Variations flaw that lets a crafted HTML page run code outside the sandbox (NVD 9.6). No exploitation reported. Not in CISA KEV, and no Microsoft Edge security release or MSRC entry for this CVE was found as of Nov 24 09Z (the latest Edge security note found covers CVE-2026-125350). Nov 27 09Z recheck: not in CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.25 (no KEV adds since Nov 25) and no new MSRC entry for it this run. CERT-Bund/Fedora advisories list Edge as affected; Edge security notes still show no fix for this CVE as of last check.
action: Force Chrome to 158.0.8127.88+ across the fleet (relaunch required) and watch for the matching Microsoft Edge security update.

title: Joomla 6.2.1 / 5.4.11 fix 58 flaws incl. web installer authentication bypass (CVE-2026-123214) and media field RCE (CVE-2026-129393)
why: Joomla released 6.2.1 and 5.4.11 on Nov 24 with 58 security fixes (4 critical), including missing authentication in the web installer on installed sites (CVSS 9.2) and RCE through media custom field parameters (9.4). No public exploit or attacks reported yet; not in CISA KEV. A very similar Drupal installer flaw was exploited within a day of disclosure last week. Nov 27 09Z recheck: not in CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.25 (no KEV adds since Nov 25) and no new MSRC entry for it this run.
action: Update Joomla sites to 6.2.1 or 5.4.11 now; Joomla 4 and older sites should be moved to a supported release.

title: IkonRAT: poisoned update of an automotive-industry business app delivers Node.js backdoor and Windows credential theft
why: Blackpoint Cyber (shared via AlienVault OTX, Nov 25) reports a November 2026 supply-chain compromise: 6,438 bytes of malicious JavaScript in a legitimate app's server.bundle.js delivering IkonRAT, with follow-on UAC bypass and Windows credential theft. The affected product is not named in what we saw; no CVE, not in KEV, no Microsoft report. Nov 27 09Z recheck: not in CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.25 (no KEV adds since Nov 25) and no new MSRC entry for it this run.
action: Use the Blackpoint report's indicators to hunt for node.exe started by line-of-business apps making unexpected outbound connections, especially from automotive-sector software updated in November.
product: Unnamed automotive-industry business application (server.bundle.js document-rendering component)

title: WP Rocket < 3.24.2 unauthenticated path traversal rated 9.8 (Patchstack labels it RCE)
why: Published to NVD Nov 25 via Patchstack (CVSS 9.8, unauthenticated, titled RCE); widely deployed caching plugin. No PoC or ITW yet; not in CISA KEV. Nov 27 09Z recheck: not in CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.25 (no KEV adds since Nov 25) and no new MSRC entry for it this run.
action: Update WP Rocket to 3.24.2 or later on all WordPress sites (premium plugin: confirm the license-based auto-update actually applied).

title: HPE AirWave unauthenticated auth bypass (CVE-2026-133971) and command injection (CVE-2026-133973), CVSS 9.8, fixed in 8.3.0.8
why: HPE advisory HPESBNW05186 and NVD (Nov 25) list unauthenticated admin auth bypass CVE-2026-133971 and unauthenticated OS command injection CVE-2026-133973 in AirWave's web management interface, both CVSS 9.8, alongside authenticated SQLi and integrity flaws (CVE-2026-133974 to 133976). No exploitation or public PoC reported yet; not in CISA KEV and no Microsoft signal. Nov 27 09Z recheck: not in CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.25 (no KEV adds since Nov 25) and no new MSRC entry for it this run.
action: Upgrade AirWave to 8.3.0.8 and restrict its web management interface to an admin network.

title: SEPPmail Secure Email Gateway 15.1.2 fixes pre-auth SSTI (CVE-2026-130637, 9.3), hard-coded GINA key (CVE-2026-124843, 9.2) and account-takeover flaws
why: SEPPmail release notes for 15.1.2 and NVD (Nov 26) disclose an unauthenticated server-side template injection that discloses account data and resets passwords, plus a hard-coded fallback key that lets remote attackers forge GINA tokens. No PoC or exploitation reported. Not in CISA KEV; no Microsoft advisory or Defender coverage seen. Nov 27 09Z recheck: not in CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.25 (no KEV adds since Nov 25) and no new MSRC entry for it this run.
action: Upgrade SEPPmail appliances to 15.1.2 and reset GINA account credentials if the portal was internet-exposed.

title: llama.cpp ggml RPC server unauthenticated out-of-bounds heap write (CVE-2026-137567, CVSS 9.3)
why: NVD published CVE-2026-137567 on Nov 26 (VulnCheck CNA); HOL and Brandefense write-ups say rpc-server has no authentication and anyone reaching the port can write heap memory, possibly executing code. Exploitation not confirmed. Not in CISA KEV; no Microsoft advisory or Defender coverage seen. Nov 27 09Z recheck: not in CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.25 (no KEV adds since Nov 25) and no new MSRC entry for it this run.
action: Update llama.cpp to b12658 or later and keep rpc-server ports on isolated networks only.

title: RealVNC unauthenticated RCE over UDP-based connections (CVE-2026-137738, CVSS 9.8); fixed in RealVNC Server 7.19.1
why: RealVNC advisory (Nov 20) and the CVE record published Nov 27 describe unauthenticated remote code execution, as root on some platforms. No public PoC or exploitation; not in CISA KEV and no Microsoft advisory.
action: Upgrade RealVNC Server to 7.19.1 (and viewers/apps to current releases), or disable UDP-based connections until patched.
product: RealVNC Server 6.4.0-7.19.0, Viewer 8.4.0-8.6.1, Classic Viewer 6.4.0-7.18.2, Connect App through 8.6.1, mobile viewers/servers

title: Mitel OpenScape 4000 / Manager critical command injection and auth flaws (CVE-2026-137721/137723/137724, CVSS 10); fix V11 R2.14
why: Mitel advisory MISA-2026-0013 (Nov 18) and CVE records published Nov 27: unauthenticated command injection in the Platform component. No PoC or exploitation yet, but Mitel MiCollab flaws were added to KEV on Nov 25. Not in CISA KEV; no Microsoft advisory.
action: Upgrade OpenScape 4000 and Manager to V11 R2.14 (or the matching V10 patch) and restrict their management interfaces to admin networks.
product: OpenScape 4000 and OpenScape 4000 Manager V11 R0.22-V11 R2.11 and V10 (R1.68 and earlier)

title: simple-git argument injection: --exec bypasses allowUnsafePack guard for command execution (fixed 4.1.0)
why: NVD and a VulnCheck advisory published CVE-2026-134815 on Nov 22 (CVSS 4.0 9.2). The --exec option to ls-remote, archive, fetch-pack or send-pack bypasses simple-git's allowUnsafePack guard. No exploitation or public PoC reported (OffSeq: not known to be exploited). Not in CISA KEV; nothing from Microsoft. Nov 27 09Z recheck: not in CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.25 (no KEV adds since Nov 25) and no new MSRC entry for it this run.
action: Upgrade simple-git to 4.1.0 or later (check transitive dependencies with npm ls simple-git), and never pass user-controlled strings as git options.

title: Erlang/OTP ssl TLS 1.2/DTLS client accepts anonymous handshake: any server can be impersonated (CVE-2026-124286, CVSS 9.1)
why: The EEF CNA published the advisory on Nov 24, and fixed OTP releases are out. The flaw silently disables certificate checks for TLS 1.2/DTLS clients in Erlang/Elixir apps. No exploitation reported; not in CISA KEV. Nov 27 09Z recheck: not in CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.25 (no KEV adds since Nov 25) and no new MSRC entry for it this run.
action: Upgrade to OTP 27.3.4.14 / 28.5.0.9 / 29.0.3 (or the matching ssl versions); until then restrict clients to TLS 1.3 ({versions, ['tlsv1.3']}).

title: Firefox 161 / ESR 153.8 / ESR 115.46 fix multiple 9.6 sandbox escapes and memory-safety bugs
why: Mozilla advisory MFSA 2026-131 and around 50 NVD records published Nov 24, including several 9.6 sandbox escapes (Graphics/WebRender, Networking, cubeb).
